stories.body: When My Chemical Romance headlined Wembley for three sold-out shows in July, for many it was a trip down memory lane to a time when they classed themselves as "emo" - wearing black, having piercings and listening to alternative music. But for others, this was never just a phase of their youth. This was a way of life. Sophie Baxter, 31, from Hull, describes herself as alternative and runs a social group for "emos, goths and moshers" to meet like-minded people who "understand where you're coming from".

stories.dek: Dolly Parton was laid to rest in a private ceremony in Nashville on Friday, her family has confirmed.
stories.body: Dolly Parton was laid to rest in a private ceremony in Nashville on Friday, her family has confirmed. The queen of country music, who died aged 80 on 25 August "after bravely facing a brief battle with cancer", was interred at Woodlawn Memorial Park and Mausoleum alongside her husband of 60 years, Carl Thomas. Parton's great-niece Lainey Parton wrote on Instagram on Saturday: "I wanted to wait until after my granny was laid to rest yesterday before I tried to put any of this into words. "From the time I was little, my granny always had a way of making me feel like I was enough.
stories.so_what: Before her death, Parton had been planning the festival for January 2026 but had to take a step back due to health issues.
stories.what_now: On Monday, the estate of Parton announced DollyFest, a two-weekend event which will take place in Nashville and London next year.
